/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline --decorate && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && rg -n "hal-engine-config-hooks|validated by|specs/hal-engine" src test tests specs .lore/test-commands.yml package.json 2>/dev/null | head -240'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
